scripts.build: bun --cwd backend run build && bun --cwd frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,green" -n api,worker,web "PORT=4100 bun --cwd backend run dev" "PORT=4100 bun --cwd backend run worker" "bun --cwd frontend run dev"
scripts.format: prettier --ignore-unknown --write README.md package.json .prettierrc.json .prettierignore .github/**/*.yml backend/package.json backend/eslint.config.cjs backend/Dockerfile frontend/package.json frontend/eslint.config.cjs frontend/Dockerfile frontend/index.html tests/**/*.ts adr/**/*.md playwright.config.ts eslint.config.cjs eslint.shared.cjs .husky/pre-commit start.sh
scripts.format:check: prettier --ignore-unknown --check README.md package.json .prettierrc.json .prettierignore .github/**/*.yml backend/package.json backend/eslint.config.cjs backend/Dockerfile frontend/package.json frontend/eslint.config.cjs frontend/Dockerfile frontend/index.html tests/**/*.ts adr/**/*.md playwright.config.ts eslint.config.cjs eslint.shared.cjs .husky/pre-commit start.sh
scripts.lint: bun --cwd backend run lint && bun --cwd frontend run lint
